recent.text: The Packers OL no-showed again against Brian Flores in their worst performance all season. We are LIVE, breaking down the ass-kicking the Vikings just handed Green Bay at Lambeau Field https://t.co/krJCLIabRE
recent.author: Peter Bukowski

recent.text: Final: #Packers 30, Vikings 10. That was as much of an ass kicking as last week in New England, just the exact opposite result.
recent.author: Ryan Wood

recent.text: Jordan Love was pressured on 60% of his dropbacks (21-of-35) on Sunday, per ESPN Analytics. That's a career high. Love has been pressured on at least half of his dropbacks three times in his career and they've all been this season. Two of them were against the Vikings.
recent.author: Rob Demovsky

recent.text: The Packers were, in a word, sacked by the Vikings. Here is the early story from Lambeau Field. ⬇️ https://t.co/sd7XYATBhT
recent.author: Bill Huber

recent.text: More cheers than boos as the game ends since it’s mostly Vikings fans left at Lambeau. Packers lose 30-10 entering the mini bye before visiting the Rams.
recent.author: Matt Schneidman

recent.text: That'll do it. The Packers fall to the Vikings 30-10 & head into their bye(ish) at 6-4.

recent.text: After 10 weeks, the Packers are going to be 6-4. They're an above average team, but not great. Spurts of brilliance mixed with head-scratching incompetence. Potentially headed for the No. 7 seed, if that. In other words, no different than 2023, 2024 or 2025.
recent.author: Matt Schneidman

recent.text: In a game where he scored his first career touchdown, J.Michael Sturdivant fumbles the kick return. Vikings recover. And this one is over. #Packers fans exiting Lambeau Field after watching their team get rocked at home and will fall to 1-3 in the division. https://t.co/Ut70rZ02rR
recent.author: Kyle Malzhan

recent.text: This will be the Packers' third division loss and they'll remain in last place in the NFC North. Can pretty much kiss away any chance of winning the division for the first time since 2021.
